evidence.description: Report number 25-061993; date of incident Monday, April 7, 2025; time not reported; location Byron, MN; premises type grocery store.
A patrol unit responded to a reported burglary at a grocery store in Byron, MN.
Suspect tried to spray-paint the cameras pointing at an ATM.
A stolen sanitation vehicle was used to pull the ATM out of its setting.
Footage, vehicle, point of entry, damage, and items missing are all listed as not reported.
